LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_MaxEventPawns_Tooltip: One incident stays at or under this count. 1 to 100, default 30. A lower count still uses that incident's minimum. A mother and child stay together.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Age_Tooltip: Ordinary visitors arrive inside this range. 0 to 100, default 0 to 50. A mother stays at least as old as her own minimum. Ratkin young keep their own ages unless the switch below is on.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_YoungAge: Ratkin young use this age range
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_YoungAge_Tooltip: On, newly arriving ratkin young also use the range above. Off, begging young are 1 day to 2.9 years, and other young are 3 to 6.9. Mothers still use their own minimum age.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_MotherAge_Tooltip: A newly arriving mother or begging mother is at least this old. 1 to 14, default 14. If the ordinary arrival age is higher, that age wins. Ratkin young keep their own ages.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ImmobileBabies_Tooltip: Without a toddler mod, ratkin under 4 stay down, and an adult has to carry them out. Off, ratkin young arrive at least 4 years old.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ImmobileBabies_Toddlers: Toddlers is active. Children under 3 can move on their own. This switch no longer raises their age.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_FemaleShare_Tooltip: Used only when gender is set by share. 0 is all male. 100 is all female. Someone whose gender the incident already set keeps it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PlayerIdeo_Tooltip: This share of new arrivals, and of people who later join, takes the player faction's primary ideoligion. 100 converts all of them. 0 keeps the ideoligion they arrived with. With Ideology off, or with no primary ideoligion, nothing changes.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Apparel_2: Plain clothes, then a temperature wrap
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_MaxTraits_Tooltip: A new visitor gains at most this many mod traits. 0 gives none. Range 0 to 3. People already here keep the traits they have.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_VanillaTraits_Tooltip: Off, new visitors gain no age-based vanilla traits. Mod traits still follow the limit above.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_TraitAge_Tooltip: Off, child traits and adult traits can both be chosen. On, children miss adult traits and adults miss child traits.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_RefugeeApparel_Tooltip: Clothing you turn off is kept from new visitors. Temperature clothing is set on the environment page and worn first. Ordinary clothing is added only where it does not replace the wrap.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_RefugeeApparel_Quote: By default, visitors receive only vanilla tribalwear, the specified NewRatkinPlus clothes, and vanilla baby and child basics. Clothes from other mods stay off the default list. Ordinary clothes never replace a temperature wrap.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_PawnHistory_Note: New visitors take one checked history. Someone whose story the incident already wrote keeps that story. Traits can still be chosen.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_PawnHistory_ItemTip: Off, new visitors no longer receive this history. People already here keep the history they have.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_PawnTrait_ItemTip: Off, new visitors no longer receive this trait. People already here keep the trait they have.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_PawnTrait_WeightTip: A higher weight is chosen more often. 0 stays out. After it is chosen, weight divided by 100 is the chance they actually gain it. The slider is rough. The field is exact.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PawnHistories_Tooltip: Off, new visitors arrive without these histories. People already here keep the histories they have.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PawnTraits_Tooltip: Off, new visitors gain none of this mod's traits. People already here keep the traits they have. Each visitor still follows the limit above.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Experimental_Gap: This page only speeds up how visitors appear.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Experimental_Note: These options change how long visitors take to appear. With one off, visitors still arrive with that incident's own clothes, history, health, and genes.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_OptimizeGeneration_Tooltip: Visitors appear faster, with less random clothing and status. Without a set xenotype, the weights on the gene page decide.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ApparelAwful_Tooltip: Chance a new visitor wears awful clothes. The rest is poor, then normal. 0 to 100, default 35.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ApparelPoor_Tooltip: Chance of poor clothes. Awful and poor together cannot pass 100. Default 50.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ApparelDurability_Tooltip: Durability percent of new clothes. The minimum cannot pass the maximum. 1 to 100.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ApparelCorpse_Tooltip: Chance new clothes were worn by a corpse. 0 to 100, default 25.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ApparelCloth_Tooltip: Chance of cloth when both cloth and human leather are allowed. The rest is human leather. 0 to 100, default 65.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ApparelPieces_Tooltip: Most pieces one adult visitor wears. 1 to 8, default 4.
